csv_project_name: Engineering Svc for Guardrail Rehabilitation & Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Stockton (City) is soliciting proposals from qualified firms to provide professional engineering services to prepare plans, specifications, and an engineer s estimate of probable construction cost for the removal of existing guardrails and replace with FHWA recommended Midwest Guardrail Systems at the following seven locations: 1) Carolyn Weston Blvd at French Camp Slough, 2) Arch Airport Overpass, 3) Eight Mile Road at Pixley Slough Bridge, 4) West Lane at Calaveras River, 5) Eight Mile Road & Hwy 99 W Frontage Road, 6) Myrtle St west of Hwy 99, and 7) Hwy 99 W Frontage Road at Mosher Slough. Contract negotiations will begin with the highest ranked firm. Pending successful negotiations, the Consultant will enter a Professional Services Contract with the City
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Traffic Design Engineering, Transportation Planning
csv_comments: '- Project Number: WT25054- Contract Participation Goal: Prevailing Wage- Project Funding: HSIP Cycle 12 funds- Prevailing wage rates may apply.- Solicitation documents available online.- Questions Deadline: Submit questions online by 06/10/2026 05:00 PM PDT
title: Engineering Services for Guardrail Rehabilitation and Replacement
short_description: Engineering design for guardrail replacement at seven roadway and bridge-adjacent locations in Stockton.
project_scope: Preparation of plans, specifications, and an engineer's estimate for removal of existing guardrails and replacement with FHWA-recommended Midwest Guardrail Systems at seven locations: Carolyn Weston Blvd at French Camp Slough; Arch Airport Overpass; Eight Mile Road at Pixley Slough Bridge; West Lane at Calaveras River; Eight Mile Road & Hwy 99 W Frontage Road; Myrtle Street west of Hwy 99; and Hwy 99 W Frontage Road at Mosher Slough.
services: Professional engineering services including preparation of plans, technical specifications, and engineer's probable construction cost estimate for guardrail rehabilitation and replacement; requested disciplines include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, environmental engineering/planning/design, traffic design engineering, transportation planning, and landscape architecture.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a roadway safety/guardrail rehabilitation assignment, not a bridge or special structural design project.
- Scope focuses on replacement of guardrail systems rather than design of significant load-bearing structures.
- Some locations are at bridges or overpasses, but no bridge structural rehabilitation or complex engineering scope is described.
- Includes civil engineering planning services, yet the structural complexity and innovation potential appear low for sbp.
- Does not indicate long spans, architectural ambition, sustainability innovation, or advanced structural systems.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the tender text. The scope covers seven guardrail replacement sites funded by HSIP Cycle 12, but no lengths, quantities, or cost breakdowns are provided, so a reliable estimate is not possible from the available information.
fee_explanation: No design fee or consultant budget is stated. Only general engineering services for plans, specifications, and estimate preparation are requested; without construction cost, scope hours, or fee schedule, no realistic fee estimate can be derived.
references_qualifications: Qualified firms for professional engineering services; no specific minimum reference projects, number of references, or formal qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text. Requested disciplines: landscape architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, environmental engineering/planning/design, traffic design engineering, and transportation planning.
award_criteria: Highest ranked firm will enter contract negotiations with the City; detailed evaluation criteria and weighting are not stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: City of Stockton, Stockton, California, USA. Contact: Alejandro Martinez Romero. Phone: 209-937-8206. Fax: 209-937-7489. Email: alejandro.martinez@stocktonca.gov. Website: https://www.stocktonca.gov/bid_detail_T22_R1109.php
notes: Project #: 864301. AgencyID: 3017. Project Number: WT25054. Funding: HSIP Cycle 12 funds. Prevailing wage rates may apply. Questions deadline: 2026-06-10 05:00 PM PDT. Although several sites are bridge-adjacent, the procurement is for guardrail systems rather than bridge structure design.

Contract negotiations will begin with the highest ranked firm.
